summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, announcing the adjournment of its Annual General Meeting due to lack of quorum. The meeting has been rescheduled for June 30, 2026. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine procedural update concerning corporate governance, not a special-situation event. The filing is furnished under the Exchange Act and not deemed filed. The content is limited to the postponement and rescheduling of the AGM with no strategic or structural changes, making this a non-special-situation filing.
